settings.title: Refresh every (seconds)
settings.help: How often the list rescans while the panel is visible (1-60). Hidden, it rescans every 15 s to keep the badge current.

settings.title: Show dev servers only
settings.help: Hide system daemons, other users' processes and GUI apps that listen on ports. The panel's Dev only toggle starts from this.

settings.title: Ignore these processes
settings.help: Comma-separated process names (as lsof shows them, e.g. "Beeper Desktop, zed") never listed in dev-only mode or counted in the badge.
